reason: I've never heard of Northline, and there are no real-customer photos, reviews, or anyone I follow wearing it. The prices are fine, but that doesn't give me a reason to take a chance on an unknown brand.
objection: I can't try it on, and 'boxy fit' with no size chart or real people wearing it tells me nothing about whether a medium will fit me. If the size is wrong I'm stuck with it, and I don't see any return policy.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real customers' fit photos and reviews, or a creator I follow wearing it, plus a clear free-returns or exchange policy.
